name: check_room
description: Check whether a meeting room is available for a requested time window given current time, room blocked status, and existing bookings. All time values are expressed in whole minutes since midnight from 0 to 1440. This tool only evaluates availability and does not save or modify any booking.

start.description: Requested booking start time in whole minutes since midnight (0 to 1440).

end.description: Requested booking end time in whole minutes since midnight (0 to 1440).

now.description: Current time in whole minutes since midnight (0 to 1440).

blocked.description: Whether the room is currently blocked (true or false).

bookings.description: List of existing bookings for the room, each with start and end in whole minutes since midnight.
